text:
emma_finance: FYI PulseLabs disputed invoice PL-2025-09 for Sep. They were charged $1,100 in burst fees on Sep 3 and say the platform had a partial outage so they'd like the overage removed or SLA credit.

raj_sales: PulseLabs has a Dedicated commit (2xA100 equiv) $9,500/mo. The spike was short but they claim many of the requests were retries while we were failing over.

taylor_csm: support case attached: https://redwood.at/support/CASE-12034. Customer logs show errors from 03:18-04:50 UTC and higher latency until 05:05. They said it impacted two production endpoints.

infra_jen: checked telemetry  we had an autoscaler miscount during the region swap causing doubled allocations and a slow drain; partial degradation window measured: 1.4h. Root cause: scale-down race. PR for fix: https://github.com/redwood/infer/pull/5981.

billing-bot: Invoice PL-2025-09: Reserved commitment = $9,500; Burst/overage = $1,100; SLA credit applied = $0; Total = $10,600.

emma_finance: Per SLA doc for Dedicated customers: "Partial degradation >1h -> 15% credit of monthly Dedicated fee." 15% of $9,500 = $1,425. Options: (1) Apply SLA credit only -> invoice = $9,175 (keep overage), (2) Waive the $1,100 burst + apply SLA credit = total concession $2,525 -> invoice = $8,075. Waiving overage is a revenue write-off; SLA credit is contractual. Need RevOps approval for option 2.

nina_revops: what's the max I can approve without exec?

raj_sales: customer explicitly asked for the burst fee to be removed; they'd accept SLA credit alone but prefer full removal. They mentioned this week is a go-live so goodwill matters.

infra_jen: ops owns the RCA, we can confirm the failover caused the retry amplification. I'm ok with recommending the burst waiver.

nina_revops: I can approve up to $3k concessions. That covers $2,525. Please add a one-line RCA into CASE-12034 indicating cause and mitigation.

emma_finance: will document RCA and post credit memo. Recording request: concession_type=one_time_writeoff, waived_overage=$1,100; sla_credit=$1,425; total_concession=$2,525. I'll create corrected invoice PL-2025-09-C and credit memo CM-2025-112.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2025-112 created. Corrected invoice PL-2025-09-C issued.

taylor_csm: Draft note to customer: "Thanks for flagging — we've applied a $2,525 concession (SLA credit + one-time waiver) and issued a corrected invoice. We're sorry for the disruption; infra has rolled a fix. Please see CASE-12034 for the RCA." Sending after finance posts docs. :white_check_mark:

raj_sales: Customer replied: "Thanks, we appreciate the quick fix and the concession. Looking forward to the RCA."

emma_finance: I'll update AR and close the dispute once the credit memo posts.
